# Resource volume

Create, delete, or split a volume clone

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* volume clone create
* volume clone split start
* volume delete
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
# cloning a volume
resource "netapp-ontap_volume_clone" "volume_clone" {
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "vol1_clone1"
  svm_name = "svm1"
  type = "rw"
  clone = {
    parent_volume = "vol1"
  }
  nas = {
    junction_path = "/cloned_volume"
    group_id = 1
    user_id = 1
  }
}

# splitting a volume clone
resource "netapp-ontap_volume_clone" "volume_clone" {
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "vol1_clone1"
  svm_name = "svm1"
  type = "rw"
  clone = {
    parent_volume = "vol1"
    split = true
  }
}

# cloning and splitting a volume using a snapshot
resource "netapp-ontap_volume_clone" "volume_clone" {
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "vol1_clone1"
  svm_name = "svm1"
  type = "rw"
  clone = {
    parent_volume = "vol1"
    parent_snapshot = "daily.2026-07-27_0010"
    split = true
  }
  nas = {
    junction_path = "/cloned_volume"
    group_id = 1
    user_id = 1
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `clone` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clone))
- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `name` (String) Specifies the name of the volume clone.
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

### Optional

- `nas` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nas))
- `type` (String) The volume-type setting which should be used for the volume clone

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the volume clone.

<a id="nestedatt--clone"></a>

### Nested Schema for `clone`

Required:

- `parent_volume` (String) Parent volume of the clone.

Optional:

- `parent_snapshot` (String) Parent snapshot of the clone.
- `parent_svm` (String) SVM of parent volume in which clone is created off.
- `split` (Boolean) Initiates a split of the volume clone from its parent volume.
						Once set to true, the clone will be split asynchronously.
						After the split completes, is_flexclone will become false.

Read-Only:

- `is_flexclone` (Boolean) Specifies if this volume is a normal FlexVol or FlexClone.

<a id="nestedatt--nas"></a>

### Nested Schema for `nas`

Optional:

- `group_id` (Number) The UNIX group ID for the clone volume.
- `junction_path` (String) Junction path of the clone.
- `user_id` (Number) The UNIX user ID for the clone volume.

## Import

This resource supports import, which allows you to import existing volume clone into the state of this resource.
Import require a unique ID composed of the volume clone name, svm name and connection profile, separated by a comma.

id = `name`,`svm_name`,`cx_profile_name`

### Terraform Import

For example

```shell
 terraform import netapp-ontap_volume_clone.example vol1_clone1,svm1,hw-cluster
```

!> The terraform import CLI command can only import resources into the state. Importing via the CLI does not generate configuration. If you want to generate the accompanying configuration for imported resources, use the import block instead.

### Terraform Import Block

This requires Terraform 1.5 or higher, and will auto create the configuration for you

First create the block

```terraform
import {
  to = netapp-ontap_volume_clone.example
  id = "vol1_clone1,svm1,hw-cluster"
}
```

Next run, this will auto create the configuration for you

```shell
terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf
```

This will generate a file called generated.tf, which will contain the configuration for the imported resource

```terraform
# __generated__ by Terraform
# Please review these resources and move them into your main configuration files.
# __generated__ by Terraform from "vol1_clone1,svm1,hw-cluster"
resource "netapp-ontap_volume_clone" "example" {
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  name = "vol1_clone1"
  svm_name = "svm1"
}
```
